programme.title: Crikey! It's Shark Week

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Beloved camel Max develops a large abscess on the top of his head a marmot prepares for her first classroom visit as an ambassador animal a peregrine falcon found at the base of a skyscraper is brought to the zoo for a health check.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet: Old Dog, New Hope
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff and his team lend a hand at National Mill Dog Rescue and are eager to find Ginger the Pomeranian a forever home a dog that loves to swallow household objects must undergo emergency surgery Jimmy the gecko gives Dr. Baier a surprise.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Blood in the Water
programme.desc: A grizzly bear charges taxidermist Wilf Lloyd while he hunts elk with his son-in-law in the Canadian Rocky Mountains miles from shore, diving 180 feet below the surface, spearfisher Anthony Segrich finds a bull shark charging toward him.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert's Python Swim
programme.desc: Robert gets in the water with Gloria, a 12-foot reticulated python, to swim alongside her for the first time in the Crocoseum Bindi welcomes home two orphaned kangaroo joeys Terri helps release a rescued wedge-tailed eagle back into the wild.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Twin Tops
programme.desc: Shaun flies from treetop to treetop in an attempt to rescue indoor cat, Simon unpredictable, repeat offender Malcolm must be rescued once again.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: When Matthew the feisty camel develops a tooth issue, the zoo staff is determined to treat him Ivy the babirusa is expecting for the very first time one keeper builds a bond with a Magellanic penguin chick reluctant to be hand-fed.

programme.title: Mystery of the Black Demon Shark
programme.desc: In Mexico, legends swirl around El Demonio Negro, a 50-foot shark that has terrorized fishermen and tourists alike for generations Forrest Galante hunts for answers in the most rugged and remote parts of the Baja Peninsula.

programme.title: The Zoo
